stock.description: Chinney Kin Wing Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on specialized ground engineering services. The firm undertakes foundation construction, drilling operations, and comprehensive site investigation services, catering to both public and private sector clients within Hong Kong and on an international scale. Its business is structured into two main segments: Foundation Construction and Ancillary Services, and Drilling and Site Investigation. The company provides a diverse range of piling solutions, which include bored piling, percussive H-piling, socketed H-piling, mini-piling, and sheet piling. Complementary services offered encompass earth lateral support (ELS) works, site preparation, and pile cap construction. Furthermore, Chinney Kin Wing specializes in various drilling and site investigation activities, along with associated ground engineering construction. Additional services extend to equipment and machinery leasing, construction material testing, and pile testing. The company's proficiencies also cover basement construction, demolition and civil works, road and drainage infrastructure projects, and specialized piling methods like pipe and soldier piling. Established in 1994, Chinney Kin Wing Holdings Limited is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of Chinney Alliance Group Limited.
